expected.reason: Real GET /repos/EssentialsX/Essentials/releases/latest response has 9 .jar assets (EssentialsX-2.22.0.jar, EssentialsXAntiBuild-2.22.0.jar, EssentialsXChat-2.22.0.jar, ...). Line 86-88: `release.assets.first(where: { asset.name.lowercased().hasSuffix(".jar") })` takes the FIRST array-order match -- MSC 1 relies entirely on the GitHub release API returning assets with the base plugin jar listed before its addon modules, with no filename-content heuristic to prefer the base module.

notes: A repo whose release lists an addon jar (e.g. EssentialsXDiscord-2.22.0.jar) before the base EssentialsX-2.22.0.jar would silently install the wrong module -- this is asset-array-order-dependent behavior worth flagging, not obviously correct.
